definitionZh: CSS 的短手属性将项目与块和内线方向同步。 它设定了对齐项目的值和对齐项目的属性。 如果第二个值没有设定,第一个值也用于它.
sourceDefinition: The place-items CSS shorthand property aligns items along both the block and inline directions at once. It sets the values of the align-items and justify-items properties. If the second value is not set, the first value is also used for it.
